hero.lede: Fifteen-plus years keeping the paper trail behind EPC, infrastructure, hospitality and oil & gas mega-projects accurate, traceable and on time — across Egypt and the GCC.

paragraphs: I run document control for four concurrent mega-projects at Hassan Allam Construction — the Dry Bulk Terminal, DP6, Infrastructure and Sewage Treatment Plant projects in Ras El Hekma — administering the Oracle Aconex Common Data Environment and leading a team of document controllers. Across 15+ years in EPC, infrastructure, hospitality and oil & gas work, I've owned the full lifecycle of a document: numbering, metadata, revisions, transmittals, submittals, RFIs, audits and closeout — the quiet infrastructure that keeps a project defensible.
Outside the register, I run Hawk's Eye Media, an independent photography and graphic design practice. Same eye for detail, different canvas.
